skills_considered.reason: The paper had already been swept, ranked and downloaded in the preceding 16-record batch; repeating that batch stage would add no new routing information.
FT-040 was already the operator-approved next cursor and had already received its P0 ranking in the preceding batch.
The paper qualifies a pre-existing remyelination hypothesis but produces no new molecule or intervention; the missing OPC and autonomy experiments must come first.
No drug or compound is tested or newly proposed by this study, so there is no candidate for a BLOCK-1 safety assessment.
Canonical corrections were queued as a commit candidate; no BATCH_COMMIT was authorised and the four scientific current files remain unchanged.

group_assessment.weighting: PubMed counts measured 2026-08-06 for exact senior/corresponding author Suzuki Hiroetsu: 41 total records, 3 with WWOX and 32 involving rat/rats. Exact Katayama Kentaro counts were 26 total and 2 with WWOX; exact first author Tochigi Yuki returned 3 WWOX records, while the total-count request was rate-limited and is not used. This is an experienced veterinary rat-model laboratory that originated, maintained and genetically mapped the lde strain, so execution weight is high for rat phenotyping, histology and strain-specific observations. It is not a primary clinical WWOX-DEE group and has a small WWOX portfolio; interpretation of human disease, cell autonomy, GSK3β mediation and reversibility receives no expertise uplift. The paper is a real wet-lab developmental study, not a descriptive series.

field_density.note: The WWOX-by-myelin/glia field was extremely thin, and no PubMed record combines WWOX with MAP2. This makes the neurite/myelin observations unusual and worth preserving, while increasing—not decreasing—the need to separate their measured endpoints from the authors' GSK3β, autonomy and human-transfer interpretations.

multihop.note: All 56 XML references were enumerated. Thirty are WWOX-, lde-model- or WWOX-disorder-direct and carry PMIDs. Twenty-nine resolve in at least one structured registry/research file; 24 occur in paper_registry_current.md. PMID 17803050, the original lde phenotype study, was absent from all five structured files and is now FT-041. PMID 19500159 resolves in the registry but has no receipt and is the load-bearing genetic-mapping/seizure source imported by this paper and DL-MECH-026, so it is now FT-042.

corpus_crossquery.query: Which of the paper's 30 WWOX-/lde-/disease-direct PMIDs already occur in the structured corpus, and where does the repository attribute claims to PMID 31340538 beyond its measured endpoints?
corpus_crossquery.note: Mechanical audit after the vertical read: 24 of 30 direct PMIDs occur in paper_registry_current.md, 5 additional PMIDs occur in another structured queue/log, and 1 is absent everywhere (17803050). Horizontal comparison found incorrect author/title metadata in PAPER 021/LIT-0023 and three boundary errors: use as a prenatal anchor despite PND5-21 experiments, 'neurons intact' despite neurite loss, and normal heterozygous brain despite no heterozygote developmental phenotyping. These are queued, not silently repaired in canonical state.

entries.proposition: The model's Wwox lesion is a 13-base-pair deletion in exon 9, with mutant RNA previously detected but no normal Wwox protein detected.
entries.snippet: Linkage analysis and a candidate approach showed that a 13-bp deletion in exon 9 of the Wwox gene was responsible for lde phenotype
entries.anchor: Introduction, paragraph describing the lde strain and prior genetic mapping

entries.proposition: Measured neuronal abundance and cortical thickness are preserved while the neuritic marker MAP2 is reduced.
entries.snippet: there is no significant difference between +/+ and lde/lde rats in the thickness of cerebral cortices at all ages

entries.proposition: The positive neuronal phenotype is impaired neurite maturation, not loss of NeuN-positive cells.
entries.snippet: the level of its expression was significantly lower in cerebral cortices of lde/lde than of +/+ rats at all ages

entries.proposition: Myelin markers and APC-positive mature oligodendrocytes are reduced during early postnatal development.
entries.snippet: the number of APC-positive cells was significantly lower in a subarea of the cerebral cortex including the WM region of lde/lde than of +/+ rats on PNDs 15–21

entries.proposition: The cortical glial result has reduced GFAP-positive and Iba1-positive measures rather than gliosis.
entries.snippet: the expression level of Iba1 in cerebral cortices were significantly lower in lde/lde than in +/+ rats at the all ages examined

entries.proposition: At PND21, Wwox immunoreactivity was not detected in Iba1-positive microglia by this assay.
entries.snippet: Iba1-positive microglia in the cerebral cortex and CC were not immunostained with antibody to Wwox

entries.proposition: The faint homozygous band is observed, while its identity, instability and lack of function are interpretations rather than direct assays.
entries.snippet: suggesting that this faint signal may be that of a mutated protein escaping from ubiquitin-mediated protein degradation due to its instability

entries.proposition: The authors explicitly identify the opposite glial sign between their cortex result and the Wwox-knockout mouse hippocampus study.
entries.snippet: These results are apparently in contrast to our present data showing significant reductions in dendrite growth of wide-ranging neurons and GFAP- and Iba1-positive areas in the cerebral cortex

entries.proposition: The biological replication is at least three affected and three normal male rats per experiment and age.
entries.snippet: At least three affected and three normal males were included in each experiment (western blot and immunostaining) and examined each day

entries.proposition: A survival-motivated litter-size intervention was applied around the earliest measured time point.
entries.snippet: the numbers of littermates were reduced to <5 pups at around PND 5 to enhance the survive of lde/lde pups

entries.proposition: The figures use separate Student t-tests for genotype comparisons at each age, with no reported multiplicity correction.
entries.snippet: A statistical analysis was performed between +/+ and lde/lde at each PND indicated, respectively. Student’s t-test was used to determine statistical significance
